answer: Each new agent locks a deposit per identity. The kernel: it unlocks after signed confirmations arrive from distinct established counterparties. Each identity is a lotus: it blooms only when roots reach real counterparties, never off another's root. A confirmation is a reputation signal weighted by the counterparty's history, capping vouching power. An attacker running N puppets pays N deposits, waits N root windows, and delivers N genuine histories; no bulk discount, no shared collateral. An honest agent pays once, works, reclaims.
